## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

## Related Issues
Closes #(issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Model / terrain pipeline enhancement

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project (PEP 8)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have not committed any raw rasters (> 10MB) or secret credentials / API tokens
- [ ] Local tests and verification scripts pass (`python scripts/run_validation.py`)
- [ ] Updated documentation where appropriate
